prompt: Write a short poem about winning the love of a small open-source project.
response:
In a world of code and commits, I found my place,
A small project, open-source, with room for grace.
I joined the ranks of contributors, with heart and mind,
To win the love of this project, so dear and kind.

With every pull request, my love grew strong,
I fixed bugs and added features, all day long.
I became a part of the community, tight and true,
And won the heart of this project, through and through.

Now we're inseparable, this project and I,
A match made in coding heaven, under the open sky.
